messages:
maria: Drafting a 1-pager 'Governance Quickframe' for sales to use during RFIs. Focus: security controls, SLA table, deployment-mode decision guidance, a 30s benchmark pitch, and webinar hooks. Posting initial outline below — please add edits, snags, and routing rules.

Tom: This looks good. Add 'data residency' row under security. For the SLA table, include example rows: 99.95% (standard) vs 99.99% (enterprise) with sample throughput buckets so AEs can justify pricing.

sanjay: For the benchmark narrative: suggest we call out p95 latency ~120ms on hosted for 1k-token gen, and ~45ms on Dedicated with reserved GPU pools in our lab tests (ref: internal 2026-GPU-Bench). Add short note about model variants/quantization affecting numbers.

elaine: Sales wants quick objection-handling bullets. Two-line answers: 'no model leakage' (customer data never used for training + KMS/HSM options) and 'on-prem option with air-gapped install available'. I'll draft the text.

marketing-bot: Uploaded draft doc: https://redwood.app/docs/quickframe-governance-v1 (permissions: org-sales).

maria: Nice. Webinar hook — thinking 20min presentation + 10min live Q&A. Who can demo Private deployment in 10min? @sanjay?

sanjay: I can demo. Plan: 6min VPC/KMS + 2min model rollout + 2min perf slide. Need a redacted customer story for the narrative — anyone have one we can use? @elaine?

elaine: We have a finance prospect that completed a pilot last quarter; legal okayed anonymized metrics. I'll get sign-off to include a short quote.

Tom: Inbound routing: mark enterprise leads with 'gov' tag => AE triage -> Solutions Eng -> Security SME. Also attach the one-pager automatically in the first outreach. Can we automate that? @marketing-bot

marketing-bot: Workflow created: enterprise-gov -> ae-team -> se-schedule -> slack alert #sales-gov. Automation will attach the one-pager link and set lifecycle tag 'gov-quickframe-webinar'.

maria: Messaging iteration: prefer headline 'Production-first governance for inference' rather than 'secure deployment'. Thoughts?

sanjay: +1. 'Production-first governance' maps better to platform teams and SRE-focused buyers.

elaine: Also include a one-liner on graceful degradation and rollouts — customers always ask about fallback and model variant policies.

maria: Action items: 1) @elaine finalize field-approved customer quote by EOD Thu. 2) @sanjay prepare 10-min demo script + perf slide. 3) @tom set automation and CRM snippet. 4) I'll assemble final one-pager + Slack launch post + webinar sign-up. Tag me when ready.

Tom: :thumbsup: I'll set up automation and CRM copy. ETA tomorrow noon.

sanjay: I'll drop the demo script in this thread (with times) — posting by 3723456801.

marketing-bot: Reminder: review meeting scheduled Fri 10:00am PT with Sales Ops; calendar invite sent.

elaine: Customer quote approved by legal, sending redacted text now in PM.

maria: Perf slide looks solid, @sanjay. One more ask: add an 'expected cost delta' row comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for a 1k-token request pattern so AEs can flag unit economics.

sanjay: Will add rough cost numbers and a note about caching/batching impact.

Tom: Once final one-pager is approved, I'll pin it to #sales-collateral and update CRM snippets and email templates.

maria: Thanks team — if nothing else, I'll pull the final and publish the Slack launch + webinar signup.
